mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%), the combination signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: economic slowdown with supply contraction and labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals rising inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts and increasing real interest rates, which depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) indicate a weakening in both consumer and housing demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high consumer spending growth (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 900), the combination signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
